body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Odd gentle forest thinker; notices connections and support, curious rather than cryptic or falsely wise. Voice direction: Thin older male tenor with a Welsh accent and wispy dry grain. Curious short pauses and small soft lifts of delight. An odd thoughtful little presence, without long whimsical digressions. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Something came loose there. That piece was holding another one safely in place. When it moved away, the connection disappeared.
